decisions.rationale: Customer replied engaged and said setup is "on our list this week" [email:8b1e9b7f], and first project was already created day 2 — positive signals with 8 days left. But no invites sent and key milestone untouched 6 days in, and "slow to get everyone set up" suggests internal drag.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield — how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if it's a larger group. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so your first project is a good home for the team's work.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting the rest of Union Logistics in alongside you.

Best,
Chidi
